title: A Volume-Growth Criterion for the p-Laplace Inequality on Weighted Graphs
summary: We prove a nonexistence result for nonnegative solutions of the quasi-linear elliptic inequality \[ -Δ_p u\ge σ(x)u^q \] on infinite locally finite connected weighted graphs, where $1 p-1$, $σ$ is a nonnegative Radon measure. Under the non-$p$-parabolic setting, we show that every nonnegative solution is identically zero, provided the volume of intrinsic balls satisfy \[ \int_1^\infty \frac{r^{\frac{pq}{p-1}-1}} {ν(B_ρ(o,r))^{\frac{q-p+1}{p-1}}} \dd r =\infty, \] This criterion recovers the known sharp pointwise critical volume-growth threshold and is strictly more flexible, since it allows…
